title: Global representations of algebras with a near-unanimity term
summary: Global representations are subdirect representations satisfying a sheaf-like local-to-global patching principle. We develop a unified and simplified theory of such representations. For quasivarieties with a near-unanimity term, this framework recovers the main classical representation theorems through a common argument and yields a general representation by factors of bounded subdirect width.
